basic_info.title: UniTraj: Learning a Universal Trajectory Foundation Model from Billion-Scale Worldwide Traces
basic_info.affiliation: not fully confirmed from abstract page

method.training_signal: self_supervised (Adaptive Trajectory Resampling + Self-supervised Trajectory Masking)
method.decision_paradigm: N/A (representation model, no matching/RL decision step)
method.notes: Pretrained on WorldTrace: 2.45M trajectories, billions of GPS points, 70 countries. Attributes zero-shot robustness across regions/tasks to DATA DIVERSITY plus resampling/masking pretext tasks, not parameter count. Key evidence in run2_capacity_diagnosis_and_scaling_review.md that the trajectory-domain frontier scales data and self-supervised signal design first, parameters second — matching the run-2 diagnosis ordering (data headroom and signal ceiling above raw capacity). Also directly relevant to the OOD/multi-city product goal (practical_roadmap.md item 2).

gap_analysis.whats_missing: No map matching, no road graph integration, no RL/world-model decision step — pure representation learning (same class as START/JCLRNT).
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Strong P3 neighbor at foundation-model scale; does not pre-empt matching or P2, but sets the modern bar for label-free trajectory pretraining.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Direct: the data-diversity-first recipe is the template for multi-city generalization of the fleet matcher; WorldTrace-scale pretraining is a candidate upstream for per-city onboarding.

uncertain: Author list/affiliations not fully verified (abstract-level pass 2026-07-11); WorldTrace dataset licensing/availability unchecked.
